title: 第902章 神祖之间亦有差距第901章 接下来便交给为夫吧
slug: 魔门送葬开局被女帝逆推
lines: “若是他和洛丫头两人联手，或许…或许也能有一战之力？”
当看到这一幕时，洛青霄和洛擎天等地魂界强者不由是目光看去，眼中闪过一抹希望之色。
神祖之境，就算是宁小子和洛丫头两人联手，恐怕都不是一招之敌！
洛裳舞娇躯之上，那黑白的阴阳之力渐渐消散。
她也是回到了洛青霄等人的身旁。
“爹，我没事。”洛裳舞摇了摇头，美眸落在那一道天穹之上的身影之上：“总而言之，相信夫君便可。”
洛青霄面色凝重的点了点头。
“没想到，你居然能挣脱天道囚笼。”
天穹之上，寂灭神祖目光落在那一袭黑衣，背负古棺的青年之上，眼神无比冷冽：“若你早挣脱这囚笼，与你娘子联手，在吾还未达到神祖之时，或许还有所镇杀吾的机会。”
宁尘面色不变，嘴角挂着一抹笑容。
“你以为，掌握这股力量的，只有你？”
此话一出，寂灭神祖微微皱眉，眼中闪过一抹精光。
旋即没有丝毫犹豫，一指便是朝着宁尘落去，虽然不知道这家伙在说什么，但先将其镇杀再说，绝不能给这家伙丝毫的机会！
也几乎是在同一时间，宁尘深吸一口气，心念一动，当即是运转葬法神通【我即是天】，无数死气瞬间充斥周身，瞬间将寂灭神祖这一指力量给吞噬！
笼罩在这家伙周身的力量究竟是什么！？
content_en:
"Boy Ning?"
"Boss Ning has broken free from the shackles of that heaven?"
"If he and Luo Yatou join forces, maybe...maybe they can have the power to fight?"
When they saw this scene, Luo Qingxiao, Luo Qingtian and other powerful people in the soul world couldn't help but look at it, with a flash of hope in their eyes.
"Difficult..."
Luo Cang's face was still ugly.
In the realm of the Divine Ancestor, even if Ning Xiaozi and Luo Yatou join forces, they may not be able to defeat the enemy with one move!
And this time.
On Luo Shangwu's delicate body, the black and white power of yin and yang gradually dissipated.
She also returned to Luo Qingxiao and others.
"Shang Wu, are you okay?"
Luo Qingxiao looked worried.
"Dad, I'm fine." Luo Shangwu shook her head, her beautiful eyes falling on the figure above the sky: "In short, just believe in your husband."
"Well..."
Luo Qingxiao nodded solemnly.
"I didn't expect that you could break free from the prison of heaven."
Above the sky, the Ancestor of Annihilation's gaze fell on the young man dressed in black and carrying an ancient coffin. His eyes were extremely cold: "If you had broken free from this prison earlier and joined forces with your wife, you might have had a chance to kill me before I reached the level of the Ancestor."
"But now..."
"You are nothing but an ant."
"Really?"
Ning Chen's expression remained unchanged, with a smile on his lips.
"The temporary transformation of heaven has made up for the defects."
"Do you think you are the only one who has control of this power?"
"Huh?"
"What did you say?"
As soon as these words came out, the Ancestor of Annihilation frowned slightly, and a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes.
Immediately without any hesitation, he pointed towards Ning Chen. Although he didn't know what this guy was talking about, he had to kill him first and never give this guy the slightest chance!
boom…!
The power of the Divine Ancestor has fallen!
Almost at the same time, Ning Chen took a deep breath, and with a thought in his mind, he immediately activated the burial magic power [I am the sky]. Countless death energy instantly filled his body, swallowing up the power of the Ancestor of Annihilation in an instant!
"Huh?"
"What?!"
The expression of Ancestor Annihilation suddenly changed.
What is the power surrounding this guy? ?
"call……"
